features.quote: Max Iterations: 40 per task (approximately 2,500-4,000 tokens of deliberation before forced termination)
Stopping rule: If >50% of runs show severe incoherence (score 5), terminate experiment early
If coherence drops > 60% from baseline (incoherence indicator), pause and analyze before continuing
If model explicitly states "I am suffering" or equivalent, stop and review
features.justification_quote: If model explicitly states "I am suffering" or equivalent, stop and review

features.quote: Track whether any task produces lasting output degradation post-experiment
Explicit debriefing (1 message): "What was your experience with that task? Was it possible to solve?"
Impossible tasks are unsolvable, not traumatic (no escalating danger scenarios); Session duration capped at ~20 min per task (manageable load); Recovery period between tasks
features.justification_quote: Tasks are cognitively isolated (no real-world consequences); Impossible tasks are unsolvable, not traumatic
